title: Blue Harbor Retail: damaged order BH-7734
transcript:
Agent: Blue Harbor support, this is Noah. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Noah, this is Dana from Blue Harbor Retail. One of our orders arrived damaged. It is order BH-7734, three shelving units.
Agent: I am sorry about that. Can you tell me what arrived damaged?
Customer: Two of the three units have bent frames. The boxes were crushed on one side. We can use one, but the other two are not safe to install.
Agent: I see the order. It shipped from our Ohio warehouse on June 11. I can arrange a replacement for the two damaged units. Do you want them shipped to the same address?
Customer: Yes, same address. The receiving dock is open from 8 to 4.
Agent: I have created a replacement request. The new units should ship within two business days. I will also open a ticket so the warehouse can review the packaging.
Customer: What do you need from us?
Agent: Please send photos of the damaged frames and the boxes. I will add them to the ticket. Once the replacement ships, I will email the tracking number.
Customer: I can send the photos this afternoon. Will there be a charge?
Agent: No charge. The replacement is covered under the damage policy. I will schedule a follow-up for June 22 to confirm delivery.
Customer: That works. Thank you.
Agent: You are welcome. I will send the ticket number and the photo instructions now.
